purpose: Fill Eira's Universe Library with a very large, organized, provenance-preserving corpus of human knowledge sources and truth-gated factual seeds without duplicate canonical claims.

corpus_lanes.source_vault: Books, reports, papers, datasets, maps, archival documents, observations, standards metadata and primary-source records.
corpus_lanes.candidate_seed_queue: Atomic claims extracted from source material but not yet factual memory.
corpus_lanes.accepted_seed_bank: Only Truth-Gate accepted claims, each with provenance, time, scope, confidence, contradictions and lineage.
corpus_lanes.historical_record_bank: Primary and secondary records preserved as evidence of what people observed, wrote, believed or decided at a time, without converting every assertion into modern truth.

priority_providers.intake: enumerate public digital collections and catalog metadata; ingest reusable full text/media only when rights permit
priority_providers.scale_note: LC catalog exposes more than 20 million catalog records

priority_providers.intake: primary historical records and catalog metadata
open-access collection metadata and reusable digital objects
priority_providers.scale_note: more than 5.1 million open 2D/3D digital items

priority_providers.provider: NCBI Bookshelf / National Library of Medicine
priority_providers.intake: full text where Bookshelf permissions allow; always preserve title-level rights metadata
priority_providers.scale_note: about 9000 titles across books, reports, guidelines, reviews and reference works

priority_providers.intake: bibliographic records, abstracts where permitted, links to full text; factual extraction requires corroboration
all catalog records; USGS-published full text where available; external-publisher metadata otherwise
public metadata and public full-text technical reports, papers, patents, images and videos
authorized/public calibrated observations, catalogs, mission documentation and provenance

priority_providers.provider: NOAA Ocean Exploration / NCEI / NOAA Library
priority_providers.intake: quality-controlled expedition data, reports, imagery, video, metadata and peer-reviewed publication links
publications, reference data, constants and standards metadata; licensed standards text only when permitted

priority_providers.provider: Office of the Historian, U.S. Department of State / FRUS
priority_providers.intake: official documentary historical record and volume metadata
public-domain texts as source documents; claims remain historical/candidate until modern corroboration
openly licensed textbook content under title-specific license terms
discovery and relationship hints only; not sufficient alone for high-confidence factual admission

mass_ingestion_strategy.phase_1: Enumerate and archive authoritative/open source metadata at large scale with deterministic source IDs and rights metadata.
mass_ingestion_strategy.phase_2: Download reusable/public-domain/open-license full text and datasets into cold source vault in bounded chunks.
mass_ingestion_strategy.phase_3: Extract atomic candidate claims, equations, entities, dates, relationships and observations.
mass_ingestion_strategy.phase_4: Cross-source corroboration and contradiction search; current-primary-source preference.
mass_ingestion_strategy.phase_5: Truth Gate admission into accepted seed bank.
mass_ingestion_strategy.phase_6: Schedule revalidation based on domain volatility and source updates.
mass_ingestion_strategy.phase_7: Continuously expand breadth while maintaining dedup and provenance invariants.
